title: Canva Launches Brush Vision-Language Model for Design Editing
summary:
Canva has introduced a new artificial intelligence tool called Brush that allows users to automate the modification of graphic layouts, layers and styles. The vision-language model is designed to perform tasks such as adjusting text and logos, adapting designs to different formats and applying consistent changes across multiple pages of a presentation.

The tool is the second design-focused model the company has released in seven days, following the debut of its image-generation model Craft. Craft reached No. 4 on the DesignArena leaderboard for image generation last week.
